title: 第17章 长剑竹简第18章 赚钱之道就在其中
slug: 我是长生者这不是造谣么
content_zh:
青河顿时一僵，随后支支吾吾的说不出来，虽然她作为青楼的长老，但是大部分都是吃闲饭的，现在直接把事情丢给了几位副使，她还真不知道，近来由各地分会送来的一些消息她也懒得弄，直接扔回去。
“果然。”
回到了房间里面的布玛悄悄本出望远镜去看，发现高空果然有东西监视这一场战斗，立刻明白这是超梦了。
犹如山岳般的强大气息从他们三人的身上散发出来，让人不敢侵犯。
也使得整个战场被隔离了起来，恶魔族和堕落天使一族的强者，被他们分开了。
战斗自然无法再继续下去。
“急冻光线。”
半空之中伊布嘴里吐出一道急冻光线让黑石呆滞了，火爆猴也没想到会这样，伸出去又嗽捉伊布的手也僵住了，他整个身体都被冰住了。
仿佛被人当头浇了一盆冷水，厉昊南瞬间恢复了理智，猛然松开手，有些惶然的起身，坐到一边。
顾筱北急忙坐起身体，整理了一下衣服，钻出车厢，大步的就往一边跑去。
“他是本宫的人。”
想到这里，北斗顿时产生了一种恶作剧的想法，刻意沉着脸，面无表情的看着令狐宇身边的男子，眼中带着一丝强硬和宣告。
待众人都出去。
北斗才关起门。
走向仲天游。
看着没有血色的隽秀面庞。
微微蹲下。
手轻轻的附上。
那冰凉的触感也让她的心微微发凉。
“对不起。”

是她的自以为是。
太过自我为中心。
没有顾及到他们。
才会导致这样。
“没错，敌明我暗，这样才好，只要得到他们的消息，立即策划一下，暗杀之后我们就可以走人了。”
林峰说道。
“你你难道还想把我们整个恶魔族都灭掉吗？”
content_en:
Qinghe suddenly froze, and then hesitated to say anything. Although she was the elder of the brothel, most of them were freeloaders. Now she directly left the matter to a few deputy envoys. She really didn't know that she didn't bother to get some news sent by branches from various places recently and just threw it back.
"Sure enough."
After returning to the room, Bulma quietly took out the telescope to take a look, and found that there was indeed something monitoring the battle high in the sky. He immediately understood that this was Mewtwo.
A powerful aura like a mountain emanated from the three of them, making people afraid to invade.
It also caused the entire battlefield to be isolated, and the strong men of the demon clan and the fallen angel clan were separated by them.
Naturally, the battle cannot continue.
"Freezing light."
In mid-air, a freezing ray of light came out of Ibrahimovic's mouth, which made Black Stone freeze. Fiery Monkey did not expect this. The hand that stretched out to catch Ibrahimovic froze, and his whole body was frozen.
As if someone had poured cold water on his head, Li Haonan regained his senses instantly, suddenly let go of his hand, stood up in panic, and sat aside.
Gu Xiaobei hurriedly sat up, straightened his clothes, got out of the carriage, and ran to the side in large strides.
"He is from this palace."
Thinking of this, Beidou suddenly had a mischievous idea, deliberately sullen, and looked at the man next to Linghuyu expressionlessly, with a hint of toughness and declaration in his eyes.
Wait for everyone to go out.
Beidou just closed the door.
Heading towards Zhongtianyou.
Looking at Junxiu's bloodless face.
Squat down slightly.
The hand gently attached.
The cold touch also made her heart shiver slightly.
"I'm sorry."
It's her self-righteousness.
Too self-centered.
Didn't take them into account.
That will lead to this.
"That's right, the enemy is in the open and we are in the dark. This is the best. As long as we get their news, we can plan immediately. After the assassination, we can leave."
Lin Feng said.
"Do you still want to destroy our entire demon clan?"
